rationale: Causative ⲁⲧ-/ⲁ-ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ formation, here in subordinate clause 'that you make known to us.' Likely a Lycopolitan causative on ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ 'manifest' or ⲟⲩⲱⲛ 'open, declare.' The disciples' standard request-formula in the Kephalaia.

Verbal noun from ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ 'stand fast' (in accumulated vocabulary). Here used substantivally: 'the Father is the first ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ' = 'the first standing/establishment' — i.e. the first stable foundation of the cosmic order. Captures both verbal stance and substantival foundation.

Possibly ϩⲁ-ⲡⲣⲁ 'on account of the matter' or ϩⲁ-ⲡⲏ-ⲣⲁ 'in front of.' Functions as compound preposition introducing the topic of the disciples' inquiry. Fits the Coptic dialogue formula 'make known to us about X.'

Final element after ⲥⲙⲁⲛⲧ 'established.' Possibly ⲁ- (directional 'to') + ⲭⲱϩ (variant of ϫⲱⲕ 'complete' or ⲕⲁϩ 'land'). Tentative. Could mark a cosmic terminus 'established to the [end/full extent].'
